score_notes.A: Front matter is fine: two-level categories, use_math matches the inline $$ at L472, there is no H1, and the TL;DR is at L11. Deductions: the install command appears twice (L82 and L536), and the full Translator file appears twice (L85-117 and L543-579). The Sources list leaks an HTML entity at L1040 ('|'). L529-530 has a double blank line.
score_notes.B: The 입니다 register holds throughout and no list follows a colon after 다. The prose is mostly natural. Deductions: the L17 heading '...프로그래머블 서빙 계층으로서의 Ray Serve' is a calque; rewrite as 'Ray Serve가 맡는 프로그래머블 서빙 계층'. L171 is a tangled sentence: '과부하가 걸리면 요청은 레플리카 안쪽이 아니라 큐에서 대기하므로 레플리카 쪽 과부하는 막지만, 대기열은 프록시·핸들 쪽에서 늘어납니다'. L13 packs too much into one sentence.
score_notes.C: L602 tells the reader how to call the FastAPI version ('FastAPI 인그레스를 붙인 버전은 summarize_and_translate...') before that version is introduced at L629. L541 says '앞서 본 Translator 클래스에 import와 bind 호출을 붙이면' even though the L85 block already had both. L732-754 is presented as serve build output plus a hand-filled runtime_env, but it also carries a Translator user_config that reconfigure (L762) only makes valid later. The 'one HTTP server per cluster' forum point is restated at L716 and L888, and the KubeRay recovery point at L15, L524 and L886.
score_notes.D: Hard parts get help where they appear: the autoscaling arithmetic (L472: 40/2=20, 20x5=100, 2.4-3), the bind-time vs runtime handle table (L255-258), the cancellation walk-through on the running example (L703) and the integer vs fractional GPU table (L937-940). Some padding: L35-37 marketing-style framework lists, and L1010 is an examples catalogue.
score_notes.E: Tables and ASCII diagrams sit where they are discussed (L162-169, L413-423, L490-498, L504-510, L872-882). The official architecture figure is missing, although it would help at L135. The duplicated Translator code block (L543-579) adds nothing new.
score_notes.F: 14 of 15 sampled claims are supported. One misattribution (-2): L935 and L942 credit agents-lib with saying that autoscaling leaves GPU-starved replicas PENDING, that small embedding/reranker models get fractional GPUs and that a vLLM LLM gets only integer GPUs. The cited page (fetched twice, curl and Tavily) has none of these statements. Two blogs are cited in the text but missing from Sources and unverifiable: Spheron (L260) and TrueFoundry 2026 (L1014). The Docker --dashboard-host claim (L979) is true, but its source is ray-observability/getting-started, which is not listed. The Ray 2.0 talk's numbers (12 workers, four nines, L528) are unverifiable from text but properly hedged.
score_notes.T1: The running example runs as pasted (details in runnable_code). Real flags and config throughout: serve build -o, serve deploy/status, autoscaling_config, http_options, user_config/reconfigure, external_scaler_enabled. Gaps: the L732 config cannot be deployed until reconfigure is added (L762), and the reconfigure snippet (L764-805) elides lines with comments.
score_notes.T2: Covers the important source topics in a sensible order: concepts, architecture, composition, autoscaling, fault tolerance, local loop, HTTP, config, KubeRay, scaling, observability, assessment. The Serve LLM metrics (L985-991) and the examples catalogue (L1010) are at the edge of the scope.
score_notes.T3: Strong on internals and fit: request lifecycle, the 100KiB object-store path, power of two choices, the controller-embedded autoscaler and its two-layer scaling with the Ray Autoscaler, GCS checkpoint scope with a failure table, proxy draining, cancellation semantics, external scaler vs autoscaler, dashboard security. Design advice reads as recommendation (L1018). The version-specific defaults are labelled (2.59.0, 2.32.0).
